shots.direction: Facing mostly toward the viewer. triumphant reveal: lowering her masquerade mask away from her face with one hand, wide sly grin, one eyebrow raised.
Facing mostly toward the viewer. grand finale: arms spread wide, head tilted back with an ecstatic smile, eyes closed, cape flaring dramatically behind her.
Facing mostly toward the viewer. self-applause: clapping her gloved hands near her chin, half-lidded smug smile, cape and short hair blown by the wind.
